dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I heard you drink a lot of alcohol. How is your sức khỏe? Uống too much rượu is not good.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: It's true I like to uống rượu, but not as much as you think. My sức khỏe is still good. Are you concerned about my sức khỏe?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Don't misunderstand! I just think Americans like you don't know how to maintain sức khỏe. In Russia, we uống vodka but still stay healthy because we know how to take care of ourselves.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Interesting. I'm curious, how do Russians uống so much strong rượu while staying healthy? Is there a secret? Or are you just making excuses for your own uống habits?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: You dare say I uống too much? I only uống a little on special occasions! Besides, sức khỏe isn't just about not drinking rượu. Do you exercise daily? I bet you don't...
